edition: Nestle-Aland 28 (NA28); German Bible Society online running text
authorization: User explicitly authorized NA28 provisionally on 15 October 2026; UBS6/ECM review remains pending.
scope: NA28 is the user-authorized provisional New Testament base. Focused checks of the German Bible Society’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not complete critical-text or apparatus verification. The newer Bespoke PDF’s preferred UBS6 text has not been obtained; UBS6/ECM comparison, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
historical_records: Existing index and reference records were consulted as historical reference, not proof of fresh complete Greek verification.

chapters.decision: Preserved command/stewardship, love/heart/conscience/faith, law/lawfully, every item of the vice list, sound teaching, grace overflowing, foremost, ages, the military campaign and shipwreck. Smoothed urged, attention, sincere faith, the trustworthy saying and Timothy’s address. The interrupted opening at 1:3–4 remains; the shorter only God at 1:17 is retained.

chapters.decision: Preserved four distinct prayer terms, all people, two occurrences of one, explicit humanity of Christ, ransom, proper times, holy hands, dress/good works, quietness/submission, Adam/Eve, and the singular she/plural they in 2:15. Smoothed urge/petitions/people. Retained the bracketed also at 2:9 and the inherited provisional authority wording at 2:12.

Modernized desires/does and smoothed trustworthy, wine and common confession. Retained He who at 3:16 rather than substituting God, and retained the inherited lowercase spirit provisionally.

chapters.decision: Preserved father/brother/mother/sister relations, true widows, children/grandchildren, living/dead, sixty years, one husband, each if, washed feet, household care, double honor, wages, two or three witnesses, impartiality, hands and hidden/evident works. Modernized third-person forms, petitions and word order. At 5:11, their desires turn them against Christ makes the inherited wanton expression readable; the difficult meaning remains flagged. Retained believing woman alone at 5:16 and the shorter Christ Jesus title in 5:21.

chapters.decision: Preserved slave/yoke, brothers, sound/sick, gain/contentment, coverings, snare/plunging, root/love of money, pierced pains, pursuit/fight, good confession, Pontius Pilate, King/Lord, unapproachable light, treasure/foundation and entrusted deposit. Smoothed ordinary verbs and several phrases; retained the repeated fight words. You at 6:13 reflects bracketed NA28 wording. The final relative construction is now two clear sentences; the final you is plural, and no Amen is added.
